changelog:
- Initial release of Nano Banana Edit for RunComfy.
- Enables image-to-image edits using Google Nano Banana 2, supporting subject preservation, background swaps, localized edits, and batch processing (up to 20 images).
- Provides detailed schema documentation, invocation examples, and prompt guidance for high-quality edits.
- Explains model strengths, limitations, and when to use alternative skills.
- Describes CLI setup requirements and supported output configuration.
- Documents exit codes and troubleshooting resources for users.
display_name: Nano Banana Edit — Pro Pack on RunComfy
summary: Edit images with Google Nano Banana 2 (image-to-image edit endpoint) on RunComfy. Documents Nano Banana Edit's strengths (preserve subject identity, swap background, localize edits with spatial language, multi-image batch edits up to 20 inputs), the schema, and when to route to GPT Image 2 edit / Flux Kontext / Nano Banana 2 t2i instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana edit", "edit with nano banana", "image edit nano banana", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.
